name: DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.mem_snkArcs
typeText:
∀ (g : DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance) (e : Prod.{0, 0} Nat Nat),
  Iff (Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.snkArcs g) e)
    (∃ j,
      And (Membership.mem.{0, 0} (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.outNodes g) j)
        (Eq.{1} e
          (Prod.mk.{0, 0}
            (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HMul.hMul.{0, 0, 0} 2 (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.repOf g j)) 1)
            (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.netT g))))

source.code:
theorem mem_snkArcs (e : ℕ × ℕ) : e ∈ g.snkArcs ↔
    ∃ j ∈ g.outNodes, e = (2 * g.repOf j + 1, g.netT) := by
  rw [snkArcs, snkArcsL, ← List.mem_toFinset, dedupList_toFinset, List.mem_toFinset,
    List.mem_map]
  simp only [repOf]
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩; exact ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩; exact ⟨j, hj, rfl⟩
